jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Business Project Managers and IT Project Managers
to support cross-functional teams and ensure seamless execution of project workflows using Azure DevOps.
This role is pivotal in driving team alignment, maintaining visibility into progress, and fostering consistent project management practices. The ideal candidate is a natural collaborator with strong communication skills, capable of facilitating stand-ups and meetings, identifying blockers, and keeping stakeholders informed through clear reporting. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about enabling teams to deliver high-quality work on time, we’d love to meet you.

This position is a night shift work-from-home position with a usual schedule of 9am EST - 6pm EST.

Responsibilities
(include but are not limited to the following):
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and department-specific task boards using Azure DevOps
Coordinate tasks and resources across multiple teams to ensure alignment with goals and deadlines
Support development teams by facilitating stand-ups, meetings, and follow-ups
Serve as a key point of contact for internal teams, maintaining smooth communication and progress tracking
Ensure team boards are up to date and clearly reflect current priorities and status
Assist in planning, deployment, and handover of completed work, including documentation and scheduling
Help identify risks, delays, and blockers, and work with leaders to resolve them
Prepare simple reports and updates for management on team/project progress
Champion consistency in work management practices and drive team collaboration
Guide teams in applying basic Agile principles to improve workflow and delivery

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, IT, Legal Studies, or related field—or equivalent experience
Minimum 4 years of experience in project management

Familiarity with project management tools, particularly Azure DevOps
, as well as others like Jira, Trello, or similar task boards
Strong organizational and communication skills with a detail-oriented mindset
Proficient in English (spoken and written) / Very Strong Communication
(American accent is a plus)
Comfortable working full-time on a night shift schedule
Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced setting
Knowledge of Agile or Scrum frameworks

Background supporting US-based clients or distributed teams
High Ownership; Cross-functional Technical Fluency; Experience Risk Management Practices and Operating in Fast-Paced Environments

Nice-to-Have:

Previous experience working on a night shift and remote setup
Has experience coordinating and delivering key cross-functional business initiatives at a high-level of impact and ownership
Scrum Master or PMP-related certification/training

jobs.title: Project Manager - Automation
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Automation team and lead a portfolio of strategic projects across productivity improvements, material changes, and business resilience initiatives. In this role, you will manage multiple cross-functional projects from initiation through implementation, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and in compliance with quality and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate is a proactive and results-driven project leader with strong stakeholder management skills, experience navigating complex environments, and the ability to translate project plans into successful business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead and manage multiple projects of varying complexity within the Automation portfolio.
Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive project plans, schedules, resource plans, and budgets.
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
Monitor project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and implement mitigation strategies.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives. The person will also oversee the budget and its allocation.
Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance project delivery methods.

Stakeholder & Communication Management

Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.
Establish and manage communication plans that keep stakeholders informed of project status, risks, and key milestones.
Facilitate project meetings, decision-making sessions, and governance reviews.
Escalate critical risks, issues, or delays as appropriate to senior leadership.

Change Management & Compliance

Serve as the Change Owner for project-related changes within established governance processes.
Prepare and present change proposals to Governance Boards for review and approval.
Lead the preparation, submission, and approval process for Change Control Records (CCRs).
Ensure adherence to the Convatec Quality Management System (QMS), relevant SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain project documentation, decision logs, and audit-ready records throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Skills & Experience

Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional projects while meeting timelines and budget requirements.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, tools, and governance frameworks.
Experience working with stakeholders across multiple functions, geographies, and organizational levels.
Knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and resource management.
Strong risk management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and drive projects forward with minimal supervision.
Familiarity with stage-gate project models and structured project delivery frameworks.
Understanding of regulatory compliance requirements and good documentation practices.
Experience within regulated industries is highly desirable.
Knowledge of Medical Device Regulations and Design Control principles is considered an advantage.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Business, Project Management, or a related field.
PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP (Project Management Professional), or equivalent project management certification preferred.

Travel Requirements

Up to 25% travel, including domestic and international travel to Convatec manufacturing sites and supplier locations as required.

Languages

English: Required (written and verbal)
German and/or Spanish: Good to have

Working Conditions

Remote working arrangements.
Collaboration with global teams may occasionally require flexibility outside standard working hours.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to lead high-impact automation projects that contribute directly to operational excellence, innovation, and business resilience while working with diverse teams across a global organization. You'll play a key role in driving meaningful change and delivering solutions that support our mission of improving lives through innovative healthcare technologies.

At Convatec, we're pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch. If you're ready to make a real impact, apply today and help us bring our Forever Caring promise to life.

A formal recruitment process is required for all our opportunities prior to any offer of employment. This will include an interview confirmed by an official Convatec email address.

If you receive a suspicious approach over social media, text message, email or phone call about recruitment at Convatec, do not disclose any personal information or pay any fees whatsoever. If you’re unsure, please contact us at careers@Convatec.com.

Equal opportunities

Convatec provides equal employment opportunities for all current employees and applicants for employment. Pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch:

jobs.title: Project Manager, Installation and Commissioning (Battery Storage)
jobs.description:
Saving the World! Help Wanted…

Budderfly is a fast-growth, private equity-backed energy management outsourcing company that is committed to reducing global carbon emissions for small to medium sized enterprises. We are the premier sustainability partner for businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurant chains, assisted living facilities, retail franchises, and more. Budderfly installs, monitors, and manages a combination of patented technologies, equipment upgrades, and proprietary energy software to help deliver complete energy saving solutions for our customers.

Celebrating 5 years on Inc. 5000 America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies list. Recognized in Time Magazine's Best Inventions of 2025.

We are an energetic and dedicated team working together to make a positive impact on the environment while providing an excellent customer experience. We are growing quickly and looking to add talented people who are passionate about making the world a better place!

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Project Manager to join our Battery Storage deployment team.

In this role, you will oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of behind-the-meter battery storage projects, including site readiness, equipment delivery and staging, installation, utility interconnection, permitting, and commissioning. You will work closely with subcontractors, electrical contractors, and utility partners to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards.

This position demands strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proven experience managing electrical field installations. The Project Manager may also support additional energy-saving efforts, such as solar, EV charging, or lighting and HVAC conservation projects, contributing to broader sustainability and resource management goals.

Why this Role is Important:

This role is essential for deploying battery energy storage that reduces peak demand charges, improves site resiliency, and enables participation in utility demand response and grid services programs. By overseeing safe, code-compliant BESS installations and commissioning, the Project Manager directly contributes to both environmental impact and operational savings.

Key Responsibilities:

Oversee contractor-led installations and commissioning of battery energy storage systems and associated electrical infrastructure, ensuring all work meets company standards for quality and safety, stays on schedule, and is delivered within budget across complex, multisite projects nationwide.

Work closely with contractors to forecast and schedule battery storage installations, ensuring timely execution and alignment with project timelines, equipment lead times, and resource availability.
Manage permitting, utility interconnection applications, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) inspections, tracking approvals and resolving jurisdictional requirements that impact project schedules.
Coordinate site readiness activities, including electrical service evaluation, load and metering data review, structural and clearance requirements, and equipment placement.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with contractors, fostering effective communication, collaboration, and accountability throughout project execution.
Monitor contractor performance by evaluating adherence to project schedules, budget constraints, safety requirements, and quality expectations, and provide feedback and guidance as necessary.
Oversee commissioning, startup, and acceptance testing, verifying that system controls, communications, and performance meet design intent prior to project closeout.
Enforce electrical safety and code compliance requirements, including NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 70E, and NFPA 855, ensuring contractors follow approved lockout/tagout and energized work practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, incentives, procurement, fulfillment, and install support, to ensure seamless project delivery.
Identify and mitigate risks and obstacles that may impact project timelines or quality, implementing corrective actions as needed.
Proactively communicate project status, updates, and potential delays to internal stakeholders and customers, maintaining strong relationships and delivering exceptional customer service.
Collaborate with Fulfillment and Procurement to manage the Bill of Materials (BOM) for each battery storage project, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of batteries, inverters, switchgear, and balance-of-system materials to contractors.
Coordinate with Fulfillment/Procurement to resolve any issues related to material availability, quality, or delivery, ensuring timely resolutions to maintain project momentum.
Maintain accurate inventory and asset records, tracking serialized equipment and all project-related materials, ensuring proper documentation of usage, storage, and replenishment to prevent shortages and avoid project delays.
Ensure that all project documentation is accurate, complete, and up to date, including project plans, progress reports, change orders, commissioning records, warranty registrations, and closeout documentation.

Desired Skills and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in construction management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Proven experience in project management, preferably in battery energy storage, solar, or electrical construction.
Experience managing subcontractors overseeing electrical, energy storage, or construction projects.
Working knowledge of battery energy storage systems, inverters, switchgear, metering, and utility interconnection processes.
Familiarity with applicable codes and standards, including the NEC, NFPA 855, and UL 9540, and with local permitting and inspection processes, preferred.
Facilities management/building engineer experience preferred.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Ability to travel to project sites as needed, with flexible hours to align with contractor and field crew schedules.

Compensation

$85,000—$110,000 USD

Compensation is based on factors including level of experience, skillset, qualifications, and location.

What We Offer:

Career advancement opportunities in a fast-growing, supportive company environment
Competitive pay
Full benefits package including medical, dental, vison, 401K, life insurance, and disability insurance
Opportunity to work as part of a team that values its members and works together to achieve positive change.

Budderfly is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status, and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

We welcome all job seekers, including those with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company's career web page as a result of your disability .

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Project Manager – Medicaid Technology & Operations

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager
to lead complex technology and operational initiatives within a large-scale Medicaid / healthcare environment
.

This role will oversee high-visibility projects involving enterprise systems, business operations, technology teams, executive stakeholders, and third-party partners. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for driving projects from planning through implementation while ensuring scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and business requirements remain effectively managed.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience managing large, complex technology or healthcare projects
, can operate effectively across both business and IT teams, and is comfortable working with senior leadership, vendors, and multiple stakeholder groups.

Candidates based anywhere in Hawaiʻi are strongly preferred.
Candidates located elsewhere in the Pacific Time Zone may also be considered.
This role requires the ability to consistently work hours aligned with the Hawaiʻi Time Zone (HST) and support business, technology, and stakeholder teams operating in Hawaiʻi.
Candidates should be comfortable adjusting their working schedule as needed to provide full coverage during Hawaiʻi business hours.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead planning and execution of complex, high-visibility technology and operational projects.
Manage project scope, objectives, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies, and deliverables.
Translate business objectives into actionable project plans and delivery milestones.
Drive projects from initiation through implementation and successful closure.
Manage multiple concurrent priorities while maintaining visibility into overall project health.

Planning, Risk & Execution Management

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, and financial tracking.
Monitor project performance and proactively identify schedule, scope, resource, or delivery risks.
Maintain risk, issue, action, and dependency tracking and drive items through resolution.
Adjust project plans and priorities as business or technical requirements evolve.
Ensure projects remain aligned with organizational goals and stakeholder expectations.

Business & Technology Coordination

Serve as a central coordination point between business teams, technology teams, leadership, and external partners.
Ensure business requirements are understood and appropriately reflected in delivered technology and operational solutions.
Facilitate cross-functional meetings, decision-making, issue resolution, and project governance.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and required decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, and third-party vendors.
Coordinate internal resources and external partners to ensure successful project execution.
Manage vendor deliverables, dependencies, timelines, and commitments as appropriate.
Escalate risks and issues when necessary and drive stakeholders toward resolution.

Financial & Executive Reporting

Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting.
Track budget performance and identify potential variances or financial risks.
Prepare concise executive-level project status reporting.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into project progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions required.

Quality & Project Closure

Ensure project deliverables meet established quality and business requirements.
Support implementation readiness, transition, and operational handoff activities.
Lead project closure activities, including documentation, lessons learned, and final project reporting.

Experience

Required Qualifications

Significant experience managing large-scale, complex, or high-visibility projects.
Demonstrated experience leading projects involving both business and technology stakeholders.
Experience managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and executive communications.
Experience coordinating multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholder groups within complex organizations.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects or a portfolio of initiatives.

Healthcare / Medicaid Experience

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following environments are strongly preferred:

Medicaid or government-sponsored healthcare programs
Healthcare technology or healthcare operations
Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) or related enterprise platforms
Healthcare systems modernization or transformation
Health plan, payer, eligibility, enrollment, claims, provider, or benefits administration environments
Public-sector healthcare technology programs

Skills

Strong project leadership, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to lead complex initiatives across business, technical, executive, and vendor teams.
Strong risk, issue, dependency, and change management capabilities.
Ability to communicate complex project information clearly to executive leadership.
Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
Experience with Smartsheet or similar enterprise project management tools is preferred.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
PMP or comparable advanced project management certification preferred.
Master’s degree is a plus.

Ideal Candidate

The strongest candidate will be a Senior Project Manager who has successfully led major healthcare, Medicaid, public-sector, or enterprise technology initiatives
and can immediately take ownership of complex projects involving business operations, technology teams, leadership, and outside partners.

Experience within a Medicaid, payer, healthcare technology, MMIS, or government healthcare environment
will be particularly valuable.

jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the role

The Project Manager provides consulting services to our financial services client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives for retail bank construction. The Project Manager will lead both ground up and new branch renovations in Florida with an emphasis on sites along the Atlantic Coast or Tampa/Orlando markets based on candidate’s location.

This job is part of the Project Management function responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. This is a remote role requiring project site visits equaling approximately 20%-40% day-travel weekly.

What you’ll do

Manage all areas of project management for commercial real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.

Interface directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project, including the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & landmarks, quality control, and risk identification.

Conduct periodic site visits to monitor the progress of construction, review the status of work completed during the period covered, review that work is proceeding in a proper manner and in general accordance with the approved drawings and specifications.

Review contractors' direct cost payment requisitions and budget status, review of subcontracts, bonds/subcontractor default insurance, review of change orders, review of Developer's monthly Job Cost Reports, opine on adequacy of contingency, review of construction and disbursement schedules, review of lien waiver and other documentation.

Review contract blueprints and specifications and opine for completeness and general compliance with commonly accepted architectural /engineering standard methodologies.

Analyze the Developer's direct and indirect cost budget including cost estimate back-up and coordinate with the Cost Advisory group performing parameter estimates, spot quantity take-offs and review of supporting documentation submitted by the Developer, contractor, and subcontractors.

Review and make relevant comments concerning the terms of the construction agreement, the submitted subcontracts, architectural and engineering design agreements, building loan agreement as well as review both Contractor and Architect's qualification statements.

Review and comment on construction and disbursement schedules as well as other submitted documents including but not limited to zoning approvals, certified surveys, building permits and approvals, utility company approval letters, soil and foundation engineering reports, and designer's certification of code and ADA compliance.

Qualifications

What you’ll need

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experience with Kahua, MS Project, or similar project management software. Experience with Smartsheet is a plus.
Ground up, retail, and/or financial services experience is strongly desired. Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems is preferred.
General knowledge of leases, contracts, construction practices, and the ability to read architectural drawings.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mentality.
Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate complicated figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

Please be advised that effective January 1, 2025, CBRE Project Management and Turner & Townsend were consolidated into a single global business entity. As a candidate applying for a position, you should be aware that while your initial employment may be with Turner & Townsend PJM US LLC, you will subsequently transfer directly to Turner & Townsend at a date to be determined.

Additional Information

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

jobs.title: Director, Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager
is a critical leader at the intersection of account ownership and account production for key client accounts and projects across Highwire. You will serve as the driving force behind marketing, creative, content, and other integrated deliverables, acting as the primary internal lead for day-to-day activity related to project execution.

In this role, you collaborate with account leads and specialist stakeholders to establish delivery frameworks that strengthen client relationships and ensure project success. While you serve as an internal lead, this role is also client-facing where you'll be responsible for supporting the overall communication of timelines, project risks, and specific tactical requirements that our teams need from clients to be successful.

You are responsible for complex project planning, staffing, and deadline management, ensuring every team is adequately resourced and aligned with client expectations. By looking around corners and collaborating with leads on contingencies, you provide the stability and foresight necessary to navigate high-visibility projects.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Delivery & Client Management

Integrated Oversight: Manage the intersection of account ownership and production to ensure seamless delivery.
Client Communication: Act as the owner for timelines and brief needs, maintaining strong trust through consistent communication in collaboration with account leads.
Strategic Consulting: Articulate strategic plans and consult with clients and internal leads at a high level while ensuring deliverables such as designs, copy, and strategies align with agreed-upon briefs.
Quality Assurance: Ensure all deliverables meet client goals, company standards, and specific quality requirements for integrated marketing, content, and creative deliverables.

Operational Excellence & Execution

Process Development: Contribute to the development of templated processes, including project kickoffs, scoping, resourcing, and contract management in collaboration with finance and agency leadership.
Creative Operations: Support in streamlining creative workflows, optimizing internal production pipelines, and refining the handoff process between creative, account teams, and clients.
Resource & Staffing: Take ownership of project staffing and act as the gatekeeper of team priorities to ensure teams are never over-extended.
Workflow Management: Implement consistent project management processes across multiple concurrent workstreams, ranging from digital and social to video and other integrated marketing assets.
Change Management: Lead operational execution and manage scope change requests in collaboration with account leads to prevent project derailment.

Financial & Performance Reporting

Budgetary Control: Manage project-specific budgets, develop detailed Statements of Work (SOWs) and navigate the budget-setting process in support of account lead negotiations.
Reporting & Insights: Prepare and present project status reports, budget updates, and comprehensive retrospectives to internal and external stakeholders.
Scope Stewardship: Ensure all project-specific impacts and coordination are based strictly on client goals and agreed-upon scope.

Success Factors

7+ years of project management experience in an agency environment, with a proven track record of leading multiple concurrent, complex, and highly visible projects.
Deep experience running diverse project types, including digital marketing, creative and content deliverables,
Ability to think on your toes and find resourceful solutions to problems without heavy oversight.
Ability to develop new execution processes aligned to best practices in areas where they may not already exist.
Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent experience). Certification as a Project Management Professional (PMP) or CAPM is preferred.
Exceptional ability to coordinate across functions and practices to deliver effective content marketing strategies that meet client business objectives.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage workflows across multiple time-zones.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

The salary range for this position is $110,000 to $135,000, with the final offer based on a combination of factors, including education, relevant experience, skills, prior training, internal equity, and local geographic market data. This role also includes a competitive benefits package with medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, generous paid time off, and additional perks designed to support your overall well-being and growth.

About Highwire

Highwire is a strategic marketing communications agency at the intersection of innovation and industry. We partner with ambitious companies and established brands to navigate complexity, lead markets, and grow with purpose. With integrated expertise in strategic marketing and communications, corporate reputation, creative, and insights, we cut through the noise to deliver bold ideas and measurable impact across B2B technology, healthcare, cybersecurity, energy, professional and financial services, and more.

At Highwire, we believe that storytelling fuels transformation. We know that the most impactful stories represent all voices and perspectives. As a values-driven agency, we foster an inclusive environment where everyone—regardless of age, race/ethnicity, size, shape, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion and different abilities–can feel safe, celebrated and worthy.

We ensure that every Highwire Walker has the requisite support to soar in their careers. Our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging is foundational and embedded in our business and culture. We aspire to change our industry and build a better future for all.

Our people-first culture is driven by four core values:

Team Empowerment
Growth Mindset
Inclusion Always
Fierce Distinction

We're looking for individuals with big ideas, strong opinions, and the energy to bring them to life. If you thrive in an environment that values personal accountability, high standards, and boundless motivation, this is the opportunity for you. Be part of our award-winning culture and contribute to an exciting and growing business where you can make a real impact.

Highwire. Above all.

Our people-first culture is reflected in the meaningful benefits, flexibility, and support we offer:

Competitive salary with merit-based opportunities for growth
Flexible hybrid work model tailored to your schedule and lifestyle
Generous vacation policy, including extended summer and winter breaks
Early log-off on Fridays through our Empower Hours program
401(k) plan with employer matching
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus FSA options
Paid parental leave benefits
Commuter benefits
Annual Growth Mindset stipend for books, events, or learning experiences
Monthly technology reimbursement
Wellness benefit program for mental and physical health
501c3 donation matching program
Mentorship and ongoing professional development opportunities
Monthly recognition and team celebrations
Employee referral and new business referral bonuses
Quarterly Highwire events and team gatherings
Dog-friendly office environment
A supportive, inclusive, and collaborative workplace where you can grow and do your best work

Location & Work Environment

Highwire offers both remote and hybrid work options, depending on where you live.

Hybrid:
Candidates located within commuting distance of our New York, NY or San Francisco, CA offices follow a hybrid schedule, with three in-office days per week.

Remote:
We hire for fully remote roles in the following states: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Washington, D.C..

Please note: We are only able to consider candidates who reside in one of the locations listed above at the time of hire.

Join the Highwire team

If you're inspired by the opportunity to shape meaningful stories and grow alongside a team that values innovation, accountability, and inclusion, apply below to start the conversation.

Please note: This posting may be used to build our talent pipeline, connect with top professionals in the industry, or extend reach across multiple locations. We welcome all interested candidates to apply and explore opportunities at Highwire!

Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

Job Summary

As a Product Structure & Pricing Operations Manager, you will lead a cross functional core team chartered with defining, implementing, and ensuring readiness to execute Quote to Cash (QTC) on new product offering in the NetApp commerce tools across all NetApp products. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within a collaborative team environment, managing multiple work streams, identifying risk, and implementing action plans to enable successful execution of the business requirements & strategy to meet launch expectations.

Job Requirements

Min 8+ years of experience in program management and/or related technical role.
Leading a cross functional core team chartered with the definition of & readiness to execute Quote to Cash functions on all NetApp products. This includes product structures & pricing definition, tool setup, business process development, PSRR execution, project schedule & risk management, content governance, and clear communication with business and content stakeholders.
Representing the Commerce team in the Product Life Cycle (PLC) core team process from concept to EOS. Including understanding program goals, requirements, and development and communication of schedule, risk management, and impacts to the PLC Core teams and program reviews.
Assess, analyze, consolidate, and communicate project status and risks clearly and succinctly to management, calling out key issues and presenting options for resolution to the cross-functional executive teams.
Apply both tactical and long-range vision to assign relative values and priorities within the context of the product portfolio; evaluating requirements against strategic objectives to prioritize investment and identify low performing offers.
Lead our Executive PRC process including working with Executives to schedule reviews, provide meeting documentation, issue resolution, and governance to meet our Sox Compliance requirements.
Understand, develop, enhance, mentor others in the use of key operational processes & tools that directly impact quote to cash and the PSRR/PRC activities.

Preferred Skills:

Strong working knowledge of the Quote to Cash, Product lifecycle, and end-to-end support processes.
Ability to integrate feedback and to prove their adaptability to quickly changing contexts and work environments.
Strong analytical skills are a must, including the ability to absorb and process multiple streams of information into actionable plans.

Education

A Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science, a Masters degree or PhD or equivalent experience.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

About Us

Innovapptive is a global leader for industrial connected worker solutions that brings front-line workers, back-office and assets together. The company uniquely unlocks all aspects of an enterprise's work management processes with its flagship patented no-code connected worker platform and integrated suite of apps that tightly integrate with enterprise ERP's, enterprise asset management (EAM) and asset performance management (APM) systems. The platform empowers operators, maintenance and warehouse teams to seamlessly collaborate and communicate to carry out work identification to work management workflows. Today, Innovapptive serves some of the world's largest asset intensive customers and helps them attract and retain the best talent with it's platform's end to end digital solutions to improve operational efficiencies, safety, compliance, asset uptime, and reliability. The Project Manager owns the commercial and administrative management of a data center construction project, working alongside the construction manager to manage the owner contract, subcontractor agreements, budget, and project documentation. Working knowledge of contract administration, cost reporting, and change order management.
Proficiency with project management software such as Procore, along with standard scheduling and cost tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for owner and subcontractor correspondence.

Prior experience on a data center or other mission-critical construction project.
Familiarity with long-lead procurement for electrical and mechanical equipment specific to data center construction.
Experience with GMP (guaranteed maximum price) or CMAR (construction manager at risk) delivery methods.

As part of the Group’s Sustainability Road Map (published 2021),

Corporate Real Estate has a responsibility to provide a Building Decarbonization Framework (formerly CNB) that enables delivery of commitments. The Sustainable Buildings Project Manager, part of the global sustainability team, will project manage defined components of the Building Decarbonization Framework, conduct technology assessments and support implementation of technologies to reduce carbon emissions and improve energy efficiency – with a focus on PV and heating decarbonization.

Your tasks:

Building Decarbonization Framework & Heating Decarbonization

Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of DHL's global Building Decarbonization Framework ensuring alignment with DHL Group and divisional requirements. The framework defines an internal global standard for decarbonization & energy efficiency that is adopted by all divisions
Conduct market research and analysis of constantly evolving policies and legislation to ensure framework is relevant and compliant
Assess new technologies and solutions that can improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions across DHL facilities worldwide.
Drive process improvements to enable quicker and more accurate evaluation of technologies for greater deployment across the Group
Engage and upskill regional and country teams on the Building Decarbonization Framework, providing technical guidance and support in issue resolution
Maintain user guides and documents published and available to all Divisions, including supporting and contributing to training sessions

Solar PV and Heating Decarbonization assessments

Conduct technical and financial desktop assessments of solar PV and heating decarbonization opportunities across DHL properties.
Work with divisional colleagues to create assigned business cases for solar and low carbon heating infrastructure BCA approvals, including submissions at a Corp Board level. Typically, 20-30 business cases are completed a year
Support the implementation of solar PV and heating decarbonization projects, including updating the online tracker, overseeing progress and coordinating issue resolution

Desktop CNB Assessment for Business case approvals

Act as the primary contact and coordinate the desktop CNB assessments needed as part of Business Case Approvals (BCAs). This includes both assigning new assessments to team members, tracking progress, ensuring they are completed to required quality standard and coordinating issue resolution
Completing, with minimal supervision, a certain number of assigned desktop CNB assessments
Identification of process improvements and upskilling country colleagues

Degree in Sustainability, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Management, Construction, Finance or a related field.

Strong interest in building decarbonization, solar PV, energy efficiency, and low-carbon technologies.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical and business data.
Confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English skills.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Passion for sustainability and driving meaningful environmental impact.

Program Manager

Position Summary

The Program Manager (PM) is responsible for transforming awarded business into successful production launches and realized sales. This role leads cross-functional teams through new product launches, coordinating Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and Account Management to meet customer commitments while fostering urgency, accountability, and proactive communication.
The Program Manager also works directly with customers and suppliers to build strong relationships that support successful program execution and future business opportunities.
Essential Functions

Manage assigned programs from customer award through Start of Production (SOP) and post-SOP production readiness, ensuring targets for delivery, budget, quality, and profitability are achieved.
Lead cross-functional execution across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and Account Management.
Facilitate decisions, assign actions, track deliverables, and escalate issues when additional support is required.

Manage program budgets to achieve profitability targets for development and tooling costs.

Identify risks early, develop response options, lead mitigation efforts, and escalate concerns when necessary.
Provide leadership and key stakeholders with clear visibility into program status, risks, priorities, and action plans.
Communicate clearly and effectively across the organization and with customers and suppliers.
Support RFQ and program-award transitions by providing input on schedules, feasibility, resource requirements, and risk.
Mentor colleagues and model strong program-leadership behaviors throughout the organization.
Continuously improve the APQP process and other business processes that directly or indirectly support successful program launches.

Qualifications

Strong ability to navigate, leverage, and continually improve EQI’s project-management, RFQ, and ERP systems.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience supporting manufactured products or global supply chains.
Working knowledge of metal components, machining, or casting processes sufficient to assess program risk and production readiness.

Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

About Our Team

Programs partners closely with Growth, Engineering, Production, Procurement, Software, and Product teams to define scope, align resources, and manage cost, schedule, and risk. It's our collective, team-driven approach that powers execution to meet and exceed the expectations of our growing customer base. In an environment where things move fast and operate in open-ended, ambiguous problem spaces, we trust and empower each team member to operate independently and take full ownership of their work. When faced with roadblocks, each team member is expected to think critically and bring potential solutions to the table. When it comes to communication, the default is transparency; sharing context, decisions, and progress freely. Lastly, feedback flows in every direction; we experiment, question, and learn together by speaking directly and honestly.

About The Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who owns the details and gets the work done, and it is an ideal next step for a candidate ready to grow into a Program Manager. The position will be largely in-person, because close, face-to-face collaboration is how our SOCOM customers work best. A working understanding of maritime and/or autonomous systems (schematics, software, CAD, wiring diagrams, and system-level architecture) is highly beneficial for bridging communications and understanding of various lines of effort across technical, operational, and administrative teams. The DPM may support one or more lines of effort across multiple SOCOM-focused contracts at once.

Responsibilities

Scoping & Scheduling

Partner with Growth to translate SOCOM opportunities and customer demand into clear, defensible scope and schedules.
Support proposal inputs, including scope, statements of work, and basis of estimate, ensuring what we propose is technically grounded, executable, and aligned to strategic, engineering, and timeline realities.
Build and maintain work breakdown structures and execution schedules that connect growth commitments to engineering and production reality.

Program Execution

Support the Program Manager across all five process groups (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring & control, and closeout) on one or more concurrent programs.
Track schedules, requirements, budgets, deliverables, and integration milestones, including Government- and Contractor-Furnished Equipment (GFE/CFE).
Coordinate design, build, on-water testing, and readiness activities to meet contract milestones, and de-risk critical path items.
Maintain configuration and documentation compliance across all program phases.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as a day-to-day point of contact across Engineering, Production, Quality, and Training, communicating objectives, milestones, and changes so everyone knows what they own and when.
Lead recurring coordination meetings to keep execution aligned to the delivery schedule.
Engage confidently in technical discussions and interpret engineering documentation (BOMs, CAD, wire diagrams) to resolve issues and keep teams aligned.
Relay feedback from field operations, testing, and customer reviews back to internal teams for continuous improvement.

Risk, Compliance & Field Support

Identify, track, and help mitigate program risks and issues, maintaining risk registers and after-action reports across assigned programs.
Work with Contracts and Legal to keep scope, terms, and deliverables (CDRLs) accurately captured and compliant with contractual, DoD, ABS, and DCMA standards.
Support field operations, demos, and test events (readiness, integration, documentation, and after-action reviews), plus sustainment and logistics planning that keeps fielded systems mission-ready for operators downrange.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Naval Architecture, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
5+ years in program management, preferably in a defense, engineering, or technical environment, including support to SOF or SOCOM programs.
Familiarity with DoD program requirements, government contracting, and recognized program management standards.
Working knowledge of maritime and/or autonomous systems, with the ability to read technical documentation and engage credibly with engineers.
3+ years working across software-based toolsets, including MS Project, the MS Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), Confluence, and communicating with cross functional teams via Slack and other applications.
A bias for action and ownership in a fast-paced, high-trust, rapidly growing environment.
Willingness to travel up to 35% of the time.
Secret security clearance eligibility required, active preferred.

Preferred Qualification

PMP certification or demonstrated command of project management first principles and the five process groups.
Program management experience in shipbuilding, naval systems, unmanned systems, undersea systems, robotics, or other autonomous hardware prototyping or production focused efforts.
Direct SOF/SOCOM experience, with familiarity with SOF-peculiar requirements, mission planning, and sustainment/logistics systems.
Experience across multiple acquisition pathways, including FAR-based contracts, OTAs, and rapid prototyping authorities.
Direct service-branch background in program management, acquisitions, or SOF operations.
Advanced degree, or foreign language proficiency (e.g., Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Arabic).

Occasional standing and walking within the office

to lead execution of work supporting the Transportation Security Administration’s Acceptance Testing Support Services (ATSS) program, supporting a broad range of testing and evaluation activities nationwide. This is a hybrid
position located in Crystal City, VA
.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

IT Portfolio Manager - ABM Industries About the Role

ABM is seeking a highly disciplined, executive-facing IT Portfolio Manager to lead a pillar portfolio of enterprise technology initiatives and serve as the Pillar VP’s portfolio chief-ofstaff and trusted advisor—turning delivery noise into decision-ready options, crisp recommendations, and measurable outcomes, while protecting leadership time and ensuring commitments turn into follow-through.

In our PMO operating model, portfolio managers manage the portfolio of work — not the project managers. Project Managers run their projects end-to-end as independent leaders; people-management and performance reviews sit with a separate line manager.

This role succeeds through influence and orchestration: shaping intake, forcing prioritization tradeoffs, unblocking delivery, and translating execution into decision-ready insights, financial discipline, and transparency for leadership.

Benefit Information:

ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit 2026 Recruiting Flyer - Staff & Mgmt

Pay: $110,000-$155,000

The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s

education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.

You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

Responsibilities

What You Will Own Pillar Portfolio Leadership & Executive Decision Enablement

Own the pillar portfolio across PMO + non-PMO work from intake through outcomes; maintain a single source of truth and an exec-ready view (RYG health, key milestones, blockers, decisions) that leaders can absorb in minutes.
Produce concise briefs and pre-reads for the VP/CIO-Staff: clear recommendation (continue/defer/stop), options, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, decision owner, and the exact decision needed.
Operate as the Pillar VP’s day-to-day portfolio advisor: run the portfolio decision agenda, pre-brief the VP ahead of key forums, represent the VP’s intent in crossfunctional sessions when appropriate, and ensure every decision has a named owner, due date, and closure.
Translate portfolio, financial, and capacity detail into plain-English executive insight and strategic recommendations—avoiding PMO/technical jargon and framing decisions in the language leaders will act on.
Run a light but rigorous operating cadence that protects executive time: default to async updates; use meetings only for decisions; and do not bring items forward until the decision packet is complete (required inputs, clear recommendation/options, financials, risks/dependencies, and necessary SME/architecture/security input) so decisions aren’t delayed by ‘need more info’ or follow-up actions. Portfolio Shaping, Intake & Prioritization
Drive intake readiness: ensure initiatives have defined outcomes, sponsor, business case/ROI, total cost, resource assumptions, KPIs, required approvals, and a clear decision ask before consuming executive time.
Facilitate prioritization and sequencing based on value, strategic alignment, mandatory work, dependencies, fiscal-year timing, and capacity.
Make tradeoffs explicit and recommend what to start, stop, or defer so the portfolio remains achievable (and teams are not overloaded).
Partner with sponsors and PMs to decompose bundled asks into clean initiatives; route work to the right leader/forum at the right stage (idea → refine business case → approve); maintain clear owners, success measures, and delivery approach.

Dependency, Risk, Capacity & Delivery Transparency

Identify cross-project dependencies and timing collisions; coordinate across teams/pillars to resolve issues before they become escalations; maintain awareness of the broader IT portfolio and flag inter-pillar conflicts/tradeoffs early.
Maintain portfolio-level RAID and escalation paths; surface risks early with mitigation options and decision requirements.
Proactively communicate and escalate: concise status narrative, early escalation, and clear decisions/next steps.
Convert resource strain into executive tradeoffs: if we take this on, what slips; if we accelerate, what changes; if we keep everything, what breaks. Value Delivery & Financial Stewardship
Track benefits and value delivery (outcomes, not activity); identify quick wins, and recommend course corrections, de-scopes, or stops when value is at risk.
Own portfolio-level budget tracking and forecasting; align spend to priorities, flag variances early, and recommend reallocations to avoid trapped dollars and yearend surprises.
Clarify financial and fiscal-year implications into plain decisions (CapEx vs OpEx, earmark vs approval, carryover risk, purchase timing).
Drive continuous improvement of the portfolio system (templates, dashboards, data hygiene, governance) to make decisions faster—and build a culture of transparent metrics and radical prioritization. What Success Looks Like
Pillar leadership consistently receives concise pre-reads; meetings result in decisions, not “updates”.
A focused, prioritized set of initiatives with clear sequencing and capacity realism — fewer fire drills, fewer stalled efforts, and fewer “everything is priority” debates.
Accurate, trusted portfolio reporting (roadmap, budget, risks, dependencies, capacity) with minimal executive escalations.
Project Managers feel empowered and unblocked; issues are resolved via timely escalations, not permission bottlenecks.
Benefits realization is tracked and the portfolio is continuously pruned and optimized to maximize value across the fiscal year. Experience & Capabilities
5–10 years in IT portfolio/PMO leadership in complex, matrixed enterprise environments; program management experience is a plus, but this role is explicitly portfolio-level (prioritization, tradeoffs, governance, exec decision support).
Demonstrated success partnering with VPs/CIO-staff using executive decision packets, governance cadences, and transparent prioritization.
Proven ability to influence without authority across business, infrastructure, security, data, vendors, and delivery teams.
Strong facilitation and stakeholder management; builds and nurtures trust-based relationships, navigates strong personalities with diplomacy and backbone.
Expertise in prioritization/sequencing, dependency and risk management, and capacity-based planning.
Financial stewardship experience: forecasting, budget alignment to priorities, variance narratives, and funding tradeoffs.
Exceptional executive communication — can compress an ocean of complex detail into the right altitude for each audience (1-page briefs, dashboards, and clear decision asks).
Experience with portfolio tooling, reporting, and decision logs strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to build and operate executive-facing portfolio dashboards and KPI sets with clear definitions, baselines, and targets that support decisionmaking.

Candidates with a track record of continuous improvement — building simpler, faster portfolio processes that reduce friction and increase adoption — will be strongly considered.

Qualifications

Certifications (Preferred)

PMP or PMI PgMP/PfMP preferred but not required Who Will Thrive in This Role
Executive-ready communicators who drive decisions with concise options and recommendations
Portfolio thinkers who enjoy prioritization, tradeoffs, and simplifying complexity
Relationship-driven leaders who navigate strong personalities
Disciplined operators who run cadences, maintain decision hygiene, and deliver nosurprise transparency Who May Struggle
Individuals who prefer direct authority over influence, or who need to “own” people to drive outcomes
Those who default to long status updates instead of clear synthesis and recommendations
Anyone who avoids hard tradeoffs (stop/defer) and expects senior leaders to selfserve in tools/spreadsheets instead of curating, briefing, and driving clear decisions.
Anyone who defaults to committee bloat, hides behind process, or equates progress with meetings—rather than driving crisp packets, real decisions, and follow-through.

About Us

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.

ABM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in completing the employment application, please call 888-328-8606. We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. E-Verify is an internet-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.

ABM is a military-friendly company proudly employing thousands of men and women who have served in the U.S. military. With ABM, you’ll have access to a world-class training program and ample opportunities to use the skills you developed while serving our country. Whether you’re looking for a frontline or professional position, you can find post-military career opportunities across ABM.

We build user-facing products, and backend platforms to ensure Stripe’s users are compliant with regulatory and financial partner requirements. We protect Stripe’s brand while also protecting the company from financial losses that can put Stripe’s business at risk. The Risk TPM team is crucial to driving programs to address these challenges.

What you’ll do

As a Technical Program Manager in the Risk and Compliance space, you will play a key role across engineering, product, and strategy to drive programs that span across the Risk organization and Stripe. You will be responsible for the successful definition, cross-functional strategy, planning and execution of large-scale technical programs that help to solve complex problems and empower Stripe and our users.

Responsibilities

Execute on technical programs that require deep systems and engineering knowledge.
Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers and other cross functional partners to define, scope, and drive large programs to conclusion.
Develop, implement, and iterate on program management techniques, frameworks, and KPIs to achieve goals with well defined success criteria.
Make substantial improvements to how the teams you work with communicate and operate to significantly increase the productivity and efficiency of the teams.
Define and produce high quality written proposals, communications and documentation.
Leverage data and acquired knowledge to drive strategic decisions at an engineering leadership level.
Create widely circulated plans, driving consistency, clarity and building alignment across teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of software engineering, systems engineering and/or technical program management experience.
Excellent analytical skills; you digest complex information and make recommendations.
You have a track record of providing program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to launch, demonstrating critical thinking, challenging the norms and thought leadership.
You have very strong written and verbal communication skills, building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams and senior leaders around the organization.
You can drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions and bring a wealth of experience, opinions, proposals and best practices.
Experience operating autonomously and leading large-scale efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in financial risk and compliance
SQL and python scripting and/or programming skills

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $157,700 - $236,500. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.description:
About Clutch

We’re on a mission to reinvent the way people buy, sell, and own cars. Are you game?

Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse thousands of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that’s just the beginning.

Named five years in a row to the Globe & Mail’s list of the Top Growing Companies in Canada and also awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and currently services Ontario, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, British Columbia, and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is backed by several world-class investors, including Altos Ventures, Canaan Partners, BMO Capital, iA Financial, and FJ Labs. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

Clutch is scaling fast, and we're looking for a Technical Program Manager to help lead that growth from the ground up. You'll join at a pivotal moment; new production lines coming online, major capital projects underway, and ambitious production targets ahead. You'll be the person who makes sure it all comes together.

This is a rare opportunity to build the operating rhythm for a company in hypergrowth: owning the integrated plan across engineering, production, and software, and driving cross-functional teams toward a shared goal with real authority to make it happen.

If you're excited by ambiguity, energized by fast-paced environments, and want a seat at the table shaping how we scale, this is your chance to make a lasting mark on a company redefining how Canadians buy and sell cars.

This is not a project coordinator role. You'll need enough technical and operational depth to challenge assumptions from engineering, production, and other groups alike.

Key Responsibilities

Own the integrated program plan across concurrent capex projects, opex initiatives, and production ramp targets. Be the source of truth that every function references, not siloed plans that collide on the floor.
Identify and resolve cross-functional dependencies and resourcing conflicts (e.g., a facility install and a production milestone competing for the same technicians or floor time) before they become firefights.
Drive tradeoff conversations to resolution with functional leads across Production, Engineering, Facilities, Parts/Supply Chain, and other teams.
Support resequencing work and use judgment to determine what can be resolved independently and what needs to be escalated.
Build and maintain a resourcing view alongside the timeline. Understand who is committed to what, where the pinch points are over the next 4–8 weeks, and flag true capacity gaps versus prioritization problems.
Use real production data, including throughput, ramp curves, and utilization, to build recovery plans when a program slips rather than waiting for a scheduled review to identify issues.
Maintain a visible risk and issue log and run a regular cadence with senior leadership for decisions that exceed your authority.
Push back constructively when tradeoffs are being smoothed over instead of surfaced. This role only works if conflicts get named, not avoided.
Coordinate multiple workstreams from planning through completion, ensuring timelines, resources, and priorities remain aligned.
Help establish scalable processes and operating rhythms that support Clutch's continued growth.

What We're Looking For

3+ years in technical program management, engineering program leadership, or a closely related role in a manufacturing, automotive, or industrial operations environment.
Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-workstream programs where capital projects, operational changes, and production targets intersected and competed for the same resources.
Strong technical and engineering fluency, with the ability to challenge assumptions and hold your own in discussions with engineering, production, and other technical teams.
Track record of driving cross-functional teams toward decisions under real-time pressure, including escalating appropriately when consensus stalls.
Experience building or maintaining integrated planning tools such as Linear, Wrike, or similar platforms, along with resourcing views across teams.
Strong understanding of production environments, processes, and operational workflows.
Direct, low-ego communication style; someone who names hard tradeoffs rather than avoiding them.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams simultaneously.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
P.Eng, engineering degree, or equivalent hands-on technical background strongly preferred given the level of technical credibility required.

Why You'll Love It at Clutch

Make an Impact: Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by leading a critical part of our customer experience.
Career Growth: Join a rapidly growing company with opportunities for leadership and professional development.
Great Team: Work alongside talented, driven, and collaborative colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a strong compensation package, including salary and benefits.

Employment Type

New, Permanent Full-Time

Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $100,000–$140,000

Competitive Compensation Package, Including Salary And Benefits.
